title: Keep the frame shut, invite one guest

beats.say: Dex's fix for Penny's embedded partner page: switch clickjack protection off.
Archie winces. That opens a clickjacking path.
A hidden frame tricks you into clicks you never meant.
Keep it on, and list the partner under Trusted Domains for Inline Frames.
One guest listed. Everyone else waits outside.

facts.claim: Turning clickjack protection off to fix embedding opens a clickjacking path.
facts.evidence: trades a configuration fix for an open clickjacking path

facts.claim: Clickjacking makes the victim click something they never meant to click.
facts.evidence: so that the victim clicks something they never meant to click

facts.claim: Keep protection on and list framing domains under Trusted Domains for Inline Frames.
facts.evidence: keep protection on and list the framing domains under Trusted Domains for Inline Frames
